english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for expressing regret or disappointment about what follows.
Use 可惜 as the all-purpose choice when sadly means unfortunately or regretfully, not to describe a sorrowful manner.
This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a situation is regrettable or unfortunate.

examples.english: Unfortunately, it’s raining today, so we have to postpone it.
examples.traditional: 可惜今日落雨，我哋唯有改期。
examples.jyutping: ho2 sik1 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 goi2 kei4

examples.english: Sadly, it rained today, so we had to cancel our outdoor concert.
examples.traditional: 可惜今日落雨，我哋要取消個戶外音樂會。
examples.jyutping: ho2 sik1 gam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 jiu3 ceoi2 siu1 go3 wu6 ngoi6 jam1 ngok6 wui2

examples.english: Regrettably, yesterday's match was cancelled because of heavy rain.
examples.traditional: 可惜，噚日場波因為落大雨取消咗。
examples.jyutping: ho2 sik1 cam4 jat6 coeng4 bo1 jan1 wai6 lok6 daai6 jyu5 ceoi2 siu1 zo2
